# Legislation fixture

`mlr-2017-30A.xml` is regulation 30A of the Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of
Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017, as published by legislation.gov.uk at
https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2017/692/regulation/30A/data.xml, downloaded on 2 November 2026.
It is used to test the parser on paragraphs added by amendment, such as 30A(1A).
